newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CBA worried about little rate effects.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CBA worried about little rate effects.

text.p: Commonwealth Bank of Australia managing director, David Murray said on Tuesday he was concerned that Reserve Bank of Australia's (RBA) interest rate cuts last year were having little effect on the economy.
Murray said another cut may do little to boost flagging consumer and investor confidence.

"My concern is that the cuts have been quite significant and we've got a question why there hasn't been more effect," Murray told reporters after addressing an Australian Securities Commission (ASC) conference.
